items.text: The New York Yankees defeated the New York Mets to win the 2000 World Series, the first Subway Series between the two crosstown rivals.
items.question: Who did you watch the 2000 Subway Series with, and were you for the Yankees or the Mets?
items.source_quote: October 26 – The New York Yankees defeat the New York Mets in Game 5 of the 2000 World Series in baseball, 4–1, to win their 26th World Series title. This is the first Subway Series matchup between the two crosstown rivals.
